name: duopore-public-climate-preference-compare
description: See which months in your climate figures fit the temperature and rain levels you prefer.

interface.longDescription: See which months in your climate figures fit the temperature and rain levels you prefer. Enter monthly temperatures and rainfall, then set your preferred ranges. Get matching months and a list of where values fall outside your range. You supply all climate figures. The app does not fetch weather records or give a forecast.
defaultPrompt: Which months in these figures match my weather preferences?
Compare these monthly temperatures and rainfall with my chosen ranges.

positive.prompt: Use Climate Preference Compare with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"minTemperature":18,"maxTemperature":28,"maxRainfall":100,"observations":[{"id":"OptionA","month":1,"temperature":25,"rainfall":50},{"id":"OptionA","month":2,"temperature":30,"rainfall":140}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 supplied option-months match your ranges.","rows":[{"optionRef":"OptionA","month":1,"temperature":25,"rainfall":50,"temperatureDeviation":0,"rainfallExcess":0,"matchesPreference":true},{"optionRef":"OptionA","month":2,"temperature":30,"rainfall":140,"temperatureDeviation":2,"rainfallExcess":40,"matchesPreference":false}],"warnings":["Monthly figures are supplied, unverified and may use different source periods. Missing months are not filled; this is not a forecast or health assessment."]}
